cues.text: Let's set up discounts and scholarships.
Open Finance, then Discounts. It has three tabs: Discounts, Scholarships and Student Assignments.
On the Discounts tab, press Add Discount.
Enter the discount name. Choose the type, Percentage or Fixed Amount, and enter the value.
In Applies To, choose all students, a grade level, a class, or siblings. You can also set dates, and make the discount stackable.
Press Create Discount, and the new discount appears in the list.
Scholarships work the same way, with Merit, Need, Sports or Staff Child types. Assign them to students from Fee Setup.
